svg.title: HyperWeave
svg.desc: HyperWeave footer banner transferred to the full Noctilucent Indigo-Ice aesthetic. Multi-pass quantized topographic camouflage terrain, 3-axis marching Bayer dither matrices, and fully resolved illuminated ice-crystal Orbitron wordmark.

rdf:Description.dc:title: HyperWeave Banner - Noctilucent Camo Dither (Finished Typography)
rdf:Description.dc:creator: Claude Opus 5 (InnerAura Labs) [claude-opus-5]

hw:chromatic.phenomenology: Discrete 6-level quantized topographic camouflage terrain under tri-axial marching Bayer screen lattices with razor-sharp ice-illuminated typography

hw:geometry.mathematical-basis: Bayer 4x4 threshold matrix rendered as graduated dot area

hw:material.surface: night sky with quantized camo terrain under graduated screen

hw:zone.reason: Discrete component transfer functions compile elevation into 6 discrete camo bands
Noctilucent identity solo glyph with singular pulsing core
Explicit 10-glyph compound path with dual ice-edge stroke and internal camo dither refraction

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Bake the HYPERWEAVE Orbitron typography directly into an explicit compound path to eliminate clip-path/use inheritance bugs and deliver complete, razor-sharp letterforms bathed in the noctilucent camo-dither shader.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Converted all 10 tracked Orbitron caps (H, Y, P, E, R, W, E, A, V, E) into a continuous, single-path vector topology with baseline at y=122.0. Layered a structural ice bevel stroke (1.2px) over an internal luminous camo terrain aperture (#n6-lo and #n6-loA with 45° Bayer screen mask #n6-mC). Preserved exact tracking (span 459.8 to 916.2) and the solo octahedron at (341.2, 104).
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Baking the letterforms into an explicit compound path increases direct path byte-weight slightly over reusable defs, but guarantees 100% renderer compatibility across all browser engines without clipPath reference failures.
hw:reasoning.hw:constraints-applied: cim-compliant, wcag-aa-gated, dark-locked, zero-js, composite-only, reduced-motion
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: 1200x200 canvas. Ground field rect (-120,-120 to 1440,440). Top rule y=1.5 w=1200. Vertical divider x=428.8 y=72..136. Octahedral glyph center (341.2, 104) scale 0.72. Wordmark compound path spans x=462.7 to 913.9, cap height 36.0, baseline y=122.0.
